definition_en: The ability to understand, select, and use digital tools, software, and technologies effectively to accomplish work tasks.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk memahami, memilih dan menggunakan alatan digital, perisian serta teknologi dengan berkesan bagi menyelesaikan tugasan kerja.
typical_tasks_en:
• Choose between two project management apps for the team's remote collaboration.
• Troubleshoot why the shared printer keeps disconnecting from the network.
• Set up automated email filters to prioritise customer complaints.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Pilih antara dua aplikasi pengurusan projek untuk kerjasama jarak jauh pasukan.
• Selesaikan masalah mengapa pencetak kongsi terus terputus daripada rangkaian.
• Sediakan penapis e-mel automatik untuk mengutamakan aduan pelanggan.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires using digital tools or software platforms
• The task involves selecting appropriate technology for a given purpose
• The task requires understanding how digital systems work
• The task involves troubleshooting basic technology issues
• The task requires staying current with relevant digital tools
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves only manual or analog methods with no technology
• The user operates technology by rote without understanding it
• The task requires no selection or judgment about which tools to use
• The user is following technology instructions without comprehension
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task only names a software without describing selection, understanding, or troubleshooting.

confusions.boundary_rule: Technological literacy is using and selecting digital tools. Programming is writing code.
confusions.example_task: Decide whether to build a custom tool or buy existing software.

confusions.boundary_rule: Technological literacy is general tool competence. AI and big data involves advanced analytics and machine learning.
confusions.example_task: Use a no-code AI tool to summarise customer feedback.
confusions.expected_labels: Technological literacy; AI and big data

confusions.boundary_rule: Technological literacy includes basic security awareness. Networks and cybersecurity is specialised infrastructure protection.
confusions.example_task: Set up a secure shared folder for the team.
